description: getPackageVisibility returns `{ "public": boolean }`, not the `{ [package]: "public" | "private" }` map the spec declares. Live: `GET https://registry.npmjs.org/-/package/%40npmcli%2Farborist/visibility` and `GET https://registry.npmjs.org/-/package/react/visibility` both answered `200 {"public":true}` (2026-11-09).
